highlights.text: Names, farm names, gift notes, signs and room names now skip unkind words, so everything other farmers see stays friendly
Report a player from their card, a gift or a farm visit if something is unkind. The Cozy Acres team reads every report
Block a player and you will not see each other's gifts, farms, homes or market goods. Unblock them any time in Friends
On a phone held sideways, the shortcut buttons now fit above the bottom bar instead of running off the screen
The Android app now carries the whole game inside it: it starts faster, works offline from the first start and no longer opens through Chrome
Sign in with Google from the app opens your browser for a moment, then brings you straight back to your farm
Gifts from the Cozy Acres team can now include silver and gold items, so we can help with projects that ask for the best goods
The jetty to the Old Mine has moved along the north beach, away from the fishing dock
The Old Mine opens at level 18, across the water to the north. Help Bram's crew restore the entrance, then take the lift down
60 floors in three layers: the Old Workings, the Crystal Caverns and the Ember Deeps. Break rocks to find the ladder down, and the lift remembers every fifth floor

Ores, coal, rubies, emeralds, sapphires, opals and diamonds, fossils for three new Museum shelves, geodes for Bram to crack, mine carts, glowing pools and a chest on every lift floor. A new Boat Visitor, the Collector's Cruise, buys spare gems, fossils and jewellery
A new skill, Mining, and better pickaxes from Bram. Your lantern lasts 60 swings a day
The Smelter and the Jeweller: bars, rings, pendants and a diamond tiara. New mine decor for the farm and mine furniture for your home
Bats, glow worms and cave salamanders for the Wildlife Album
A slimmer banner in the Wild Woods: the places sit in one row you can swipe, so the woods are not hidden on phones. Tips now pop up below the banner
Fixed: pressing back while taking photos inside your home (or in the village and the woods) left you on an empty screen. Back now just closes Photo mode
A camera button in your home (and in a friend's): take photos of your rooms with Photo mode
Tap Hang at home on any photo, then pick it on a picture frame. Your home keeps up to 6, and friends who visit see them
Everyone comes out to be in the picture, even while you are decorating
Fixed: visiting a friend's home, their farmer showed up twice (or more) after changing rooms
Make any piece smaller or bigger: tap - or + by its name (50% to 150%), or the size to put it back as made
Your furniture now adds charm to your farm: the more you furnish, the more charm
In Decorate everyone steps out of sight so nobody is in your way; switch to Relax to see them again
Patterned rugs, windows, frames and handmade pieces now show a real preview in the catalogue
Your home now opens at level 15 instead of 30, so you can start furnishing much sooner
Your farmer now lives in your home: switch to Relax, tap the floor to walk and tap a chair, sofa or bed to sit down
Villagers drop in during the day to look round, sit a while and chat
Visiting a friend's farm? Tap Go inside to see their home, and Have a coffee to sit down together. They'll hear you came over
Five patterned rugs: any floor or wallpaper pattern in your own colours, with a border to match
Everyone walks round your furniture and steps aside when you put a piece down
Books, plants and other small things now go on wall shelves and on the shelves inside bookcases: drag them to the shelf you want
Whatever stands on a wall shelf now moves with it when you move or turn the shelf
A colour you pick now looks the same on every piece of furniture: country sofas, beds, shelves and kitchen pieces came out much darker than the swatch
Step inside your Farmhouse from level 30: tap the door above it or Go inside on the Farmhouse screen
Over 250 pieces of furniture to arrange however you like: sofas, beds, kitchens, bathrooms, lamps, rugs, plants, windows, curtains, a fireplace and more
Paper and paint every wall on its own, give the lower walls their own look, and pick any floor, all in any colours you like
Recolour every part of a piece (a sofa's fabric and its legs), copy a style to another piece, and switch lamps on for cosy nights
Hang your Wildlife Album photos, your best catches and your finds in frames and on plaques
A new room opens with each Farmhouse level, nine in all, and each can be made roomier or grand
Keep three looks for every room and swap between them any time, with undo for every change
Make handmade pieces at the Carpenter's Workshop from things you gather, and receive a set from each villager as your friendship grows
New tools behind the scenes to keep the village kind and friendly for everyone
Small fixes to how some screens are drawn
The Halloween look has been taken away: the farm, the villagers and the screens are back to their usual cosy selves
Your own Farm look choice in Settings (spring, summer, autumn, winter or auto) works just as before
Fixed: with the Halloween look on, the spooky glow round the screen caught every touch, so you could not move around or tap your farm
Messages that pop up at the top no longer block taps underneath them
Big farms are shared with neighbours again: farms with lots of paths, fences and decorations could stop updating, so visitors saw an old farm and could not help with what was really there
Lend a hand at a busy workshop when you visit: it finishes your neighbour's goods sooner
When everything on a farm is already done, the visit says so instead of leaving you looking for something to help with
Village Projects: a gift sent while the connection drops is set aside and delivered once, as soon as you are back online
If a host deletes their account, everyone who gave to their open project still gets their goods back
A toast when a friend starts a new Village Project, and finished projects are found even when your friends list is empty
Farmhands show when their next round is, never spend the coins set aside for their wages on seeds, and no longer start working the moment you give them a new job
A hint when a wild visitor turns up at the edge of your farm, and visitors that have wandered off no longer block your taps in the woods
Leaderboards: loading an older save no longer drops you down the boards or hides you
Halloween decorations stay on your own farm when you visit a friend, and the Clock Tower keeps time without slowing the square
Village Projects: host a project with your friends (the Friendship Footbridge, a Community Garden or Fireworks Night) and build it together. Open Village, then Village Projects
Everyone who helps gets the project's decoration for their farm and a Friendship Plaque with all your names
Nothing is ever lost: if a project runs out of time, everyone gets back exactly what they gave

releases.title: The Treehouse and the Wildlife Album

highlights.text: The Wildlife Album: deer, foxes, ducks, herons, otters, owls, robins, badgers and more visit the Wild Woods and the edge of your farm at their own times and in their own weather. Tap one to take its photo, and complete a set for a reward. Look out for penguins and a polar bear on festival days!
Build a treehouse in the great pine in Whispering Pines (from level 45), then furnish it with log chairs, a mushroom lamp, lanterns, a moss rug, a bookshelf and a telescope
A finished treehouse brings 2 more finds to every camp morning, and the telescope shows which wild animals are out today in your album
The Clock Tower (level 70): build it with Bram in four stages, from the foundations to the bell. Its clock keeps the real time and chimes on the hour in the village square
The Lighthouse (level 80): light the old lighthouse on the point with Old Tom. Its beam sweeps the bay every night, and Boat Visitors call three days a week instead of two
Each finished project gives you a model of it for your own farm. Find the Estate Projects in the Village screen once the village square is rebuilt

Farmhands: from level 50 hire Fern, then Ollie (70) and Mabel (90). Each takes one chore: replanting your harvested fields, feeding an animal home or keeping a workshop busy. They are paid on the days they work, rest on festival days, and never sell anything for you
Mastery lines: every crop and workshop you master now gets a bonus of your choice for good: more harvest or double batches, a better gold-star chance, or faster growing and making
Find your farmhands on the Farmhouse screen, and your mastery lines in Me > Mastery
The Tea House (level 106): grow tea leaves and brew green tea, mint tea, honey tea, chai and iced tea, with matcha cake and tea biscuits
The Florist (level 112): grow roses and tie bouquets, buttonholes, flower crowns, wreaths and rose water. Every villager loves a bouquet, the best gift there is
Best friends have a new story to tell: Rosa's cookbook, Old Tom's boat, Juniper's art show, Pip's treasure hunt, Hazel's village records and Bram's bell, told in letters over a week
A fifth place in the Wild Woods: restore the Root Path from level 40 to reach the Ancient Grove, with acorns and moonflowers to forage

Wake the Elder Oak: five stages over many weeks, each with gifts from the woods, the Lodge and your best gold-star goods. Every stage gives a lasting woods bonus: brighter forage, an extra pan, critters visiting twice a day, and a glowing canopy with an extra dig
Grow the oak to its full crown for a sapling of the Elder Oak for your farm, plus acorn bread and moonflower tea at the Woodcraft Lodge
New for levels 101-120: peach, plum and olive trees, and rice, garlic, sweet potatoes and cranberries for your fields
12 new dishes: peach cobbler, plum cake, risotto, fried rice, olive focaccia, olive oil, cranberry sauce, peach sorbet and more, wanted by boats and villagers
Farmhouse level 15 raises your limits again, four orchard decorations, a new Master challenge in the Wild Woods, and fairer leaderboards

The Woodcraft Lodge: restore the Hollow Bridge in the Wild Woods to build it, then turn your woods finds into elderberry cordial, herbal salve, holly and pinecone wreaths, maple candy, a Woodland Feast and more
Go camping: pitch a tent at the campsite in the woods any evening and wake up to a basket of finds round the camp
Woods weather: rain brings mushrooms to every patch, mist makes rare finds likelier, and sunshine brings berries and flowers

Spooky season is here until Halloween: a twilight sky, glowing jack-o'-lanterns round the farm and floating overhead, Halloween bunting, friendly ghosts, bats, drifting mist, autumn leaves and a witch who zooms past on her broomstick
The whole game dresses up too: pumpkin-orange and witch-purple screens, cobwebs in the corners, a moonlit loading screen and a countdown to Halloween night
The villagers are in costume too. It is only a look and changes nothing in the game: switch it off in Settings if you prefer
Six critter families live in the Wild Woods: leave a treat on their feeding stump and deer, rabbits, hedgehogs, foxes, squirrels and owls come to visit at their own time of day
Visit them to earn hearts and gifts, collect their special gifts for a new Museum shelf, and follow them all in the new Critter Journal
Wren the ranger has moved into Whispering Pines: help with her field notes every day
Care and Craft: upgrade the Vet's Cottage and the Carpenter's Workshop for cheaper care, daily check-ups and fresh paint, and do all your care in one tap with the Care round on the Farmhouse

Everything now has a use: 27 new dishes and crafts for every fish, woods find and creek treasure, two new Museum shelves (Creek Treasures and The Aquarium), and two new boats, the Picnic Cruise and the Craft Fair Cruise
Fixed: some decorations, such as the Water Tower and Lookout Tower, could vanish from view and leave only their shadow. They are all back where you placed them
The Wild Woods grow into a forest: restore three trails to reach Mossy Hollow, Crystal Creek and Whispering Pines, each with its own wild finds
Catch fireflies over Mossy Hollow at night, pan for gold, agate, jade and river pearls in Crystal Creek, and tap the old pines for maple sap and resin
Use the new buttons on the woods banner to fly between the glade and the three regions

Behind the village square stands Willowmere, the old manor house. Once all six rooms are rebuilt, restore it wing by wing: eight wings, each asking a great deal and each giving something to your farm for good
Watch the manor rise in the square as you go, from an overgrown ruin to the Grand Ballroom, and keep a model of it for your own farm when it opens
Fixed: coins you had paid part-way into a Treasury chest are no longer lost when the game reloads
Past level 60, every level now takes the same effort as level 60 instead of getting steeper each time
From level 60, Master Challenges, boat visitors and festival prizes also give a good share of XP toward your next level
Level Markers, trophies and streak plaques now add up to 500 charm in total, so the charm board is about decorating again
Big, beautifully decorated farms run much more smoothly: decorations are now drawn together instead of one by one
The farm opens faster: the game only loads what your farm needs right now, and the rest arrives when you first use it
Back from a break? Nothing wanders off on your first day back, and every unwell animal gets at least two more days to see the vet
Your farm is safer: a save the game cannot read is now kept aside instead of being replaced, and a farm saved by a newer version asks you to update first
Master Challenges: "Pat your animals" now counts the Pat button on each animal
Pea Soup, Lavender Candles, Lavender Honey and Blueberry Muffins now sell for more than their ingredients, and Potter's Clay needs less beetroot
Animals now grow older and sometimes fall unwell from level 12. The new Vet's Cottage treats them for a few coins; leave them and they may wander off
Workshops and animal homes slowly wear down. Worn ones work a little slower, and a broken one needs the new Carpenter's Workshop to repair it before it can start new jobs
Wandered animals can be brought back for a small fee within a few days. Days away count more slowly, and nothing is ever lost while you are away
New Master Board from level 50: three Master Challenges every Monday for coins and gems, a bonus crate when you finish them all, and a streak that wins a big-number prize
The Gem Boutique: gem-only decorations such as model ships, houseboats, a treasure chest and a little jetty. Six new things are on offer every Monday
Levels 81 to 100: avocado, celery, lettuce and golden pumpkins, 12 new dishes and Farmhouse levels 13 and 14
Nearly 90 new decorations in sets: Produce Market, Harvest Night, a build-your-own Minigolf course, Porch, Farm Railway, Winter, Farm Kitchen and a Little Village of houses
Boat Visitors now arrive in a different boat for every theme
There is no top level any more! Keep levelling up for ever, with coins and gems at every level
Level Markers: every level from 61 up hands you a big number of that level for your farm. The colour changes every ten levels
12 new dishes for levels 61 to 78, from spaghetti and mushroom pizza to chocolate cake and the Harvest Banquet
Farmhouse levels 11 and 12 (player levels 70 and 80) raise every limit again
Six new decorations for levels 62 to 79. More content will keep arriving for the levels beyond
Leaderboard trophies: finish 1st, 2nd, 3rd or in the top 10 on any leaderboard and win a giant big-number trophy for your farm. Everyone who visits will see it
Each of the four boards (Level, Farm Value, Charm and Weekly XP) has its own set, with a flag in the board's colour. Find your trophies in the Leaders screen
Trophies are yours to keep for good once earned, and wait in your storage until you place them
Levels 51 to 60 are here! The level cap is raised from 50 to 60, with coins and gems at every level
Two new crops: mushrooms (level 51) and giant pumpkins (level 54)
7 new dishes: muffins, waffles, mushroom soup, garden wraps, watermelon juice, pumpkin spice cake and the Celebration Cake
Farmhouse levels 9 and 10 (player levels 52 and 58) raise every limit again, including a fourth workshop of each kind
Six new decorations, from an Old Oak and a Little Grove to a golden Grand Master Statue at level 60

releases.title: More to Grow, Bake and Love

highlights.text: Four new late-game crops: sunflowers, potatoes, pineapples and leeks (levels 41 to 47)
13 new recipes: croissants, baguettes, cupcakes, doughnuts, sandwiches, salads and more
Bunnies! A new Rabbit Hutch (level 21) gives soft angora. Every animal now has a name and can be patted once a day; hearts grow and make better produce
Boat Visitors: on two days a week a themed boat ties up at the dock from 10 am to 5 pm. Hand over their wish list for coins and gems
14 new decorations, and a new Farm look setting (Settings) that tints your farm to a season if you like. It is only for looks
Build mode has Select many: swipe across pieces of the same kind (decor, fences, paths) like harvesting crops, then store them all in one go
The haze is much thinner: you can see the whole farm clearly when zoomed out, at night, and in rain or mist
Fixed helping friends: fields, buildings and scarecrows on top of paths or fields were missing on visited farms, so the Water / Feed / Tend buttons never appeared there
Fixed the Village Square top bar on narrow phones, where the title was squeezed into one letter per line and covered the village
The seasons are gone for now: every crop can be planted all year again, and the season badge and the changing look of the farm have been removed
Festivals stay, one every 7 days in turn, and the new fish and wild plants are available all year
The Glass Frame is gone too. If you bought one, your 900 coins are returned
Fish that an order or a Help Wanted request needs now bite more readily, and glow in the Biting list while you fish
New Lucky Bait (tap the golden worm while fishing, 3 for 120 coins): when something you need is biting, it makes that fish about three times more likely. It is only used up when it can help
Everyday fish are back to their old catch rates (the new seasonal fish have their own small chance), and orders ask for fewer fish
The season badge on the top bar is smaller so it is no longer cut off. Tap it for the full season

The valley now has four seasons, seven days each. Most crops grow only in their seasons, grow faster and give more silver and gold when planted in season, and keep growing when the season changes. Wheat, corn, carrots and turnips grow all year. The season is shown on the top bar
Festival days: the last day of every season is a festival with a mini-game (Egg Hunt, Fishing Derby, Harvest Fair, Feast of Lights), prizes, a decoration and a ribbon for your Almanac
The Wild Woods (level 14): row over from your south beach to pick seasonal wild plants, dig up minerals, fossils and artifacts, and grow your new Foraging skill. Everything comes back each day
The Museum in the woods: give one of each find to fill its shelves for rewards and become the Curator. Send villagers on expeditions from the board there to bring back more finds

A Help Wanted board in the Village with three neighbours' requests a day, new heart events at 2, 6 and 10 hearts, villagers now have daily routines (you may find Rosa or Pip wandering the Wild Woods, and each villager's page says where they are), and your pet digs up a little something for you every day (tap it)

16 new seasonal fish, a Glass Frame that lets a field grow any crop in any season, and a changing look for each season. The seasonal events (acorns, petals, seashells, snowflakes) now follow the valley's seasons
The Collection Book has nine new pages, an Almanac page shows the whole year at a glance, and objects now have a Path under button
Laying paths and fences is easier: after you place one, the next appears right beside it, and once two are down it carries on in the same direction. Just keep tapping Confirm
The travelling merchant now sails in to the dock, climbs the new wooden steps onto your farm, sets up his cart and wanders around your farm until his visit ends. Then he walks back and sails away
Marlow Pike arrives by boat when his night hours begin and sails away again when they end
Marlow Pike has set up a fish stall by the dock on the north beach. He is a night trader (7 pm to 7 am), sells fish at ridiculous prices, and has a small fresh stock every night
Handy when an order needs a fish you have not caught yet, but fishing it yourself always pays far better
Beehive House (level 20): bees turn apples into honey, honeycomb, beeswax candles and honey butter
Ducks (level 24): build a Duck House and collect duck eggs. Duck Feed is made at the Feed Mill
Juice Press (level 26): apple, berry, grape and orange juice
Blueberries (level 30): a new crop, with blueberry juice and blueberry muffins
Pottery Kiln (level 34): fire potter's clay into pots, vases and glazed tiles, plus a new Glazed Tiles path
Horses (level 36): build a Stable for horses that give fertiliser. Each horse brings the delivery truck back 10% sooner, up to three
Peas and Lavender (level 38): two new crops, with pea soup at the Village Kitchen and lavender honey and candles at the Beehive House
Mastery (level 40): grow gold crops and make gold goods to master every crop and workshop, for coins, gems and Mastery Plaques. See Me > Mastery
Neater farms: lay paths under benches, lanterns and other things, and stand scarecrows, signs, sprinklers and other small items right in your fields
New Village Hero title on your farmer screen once you have rebuilt every room of the square
Row over to the old village square and rebuild all six rooms: the Pantry, Barn Room, Pier, Kitchen, Workshop and Treasury
Fill each room's bundles with crops, animal goods or coins. A friend can send what you are missing
Skills grow as you play: Farming, Animals, Fishing and Cooking, and Crafting once Bram's forge is lit. Choose a perk at levels 5 and 10
Rebuilt rooms help your farm for good: rare seeds, faster animals, a second fishing spot, new workshops, crafted helpers, better trucks and a Saturday market day

items.text: Look for the signpost and little boat on your farm's east beach, or open Village and tap Go
Watch each room change as you give: a ruin, bare ground, a frame, then a finished building with a celebration
Every bundle you fill brings you closer to the villager who owns that room, and a finished room brings a letter
Rebuild every room and the whole valley throws a festival: a golden statue, bunting, and a thank-you from Hazel
The Pier (level 18): Old Tom's jetty on your west beach is a second fishing spot with nine new fish
The Kitchen (level 22): build the Village Kitchen workshop for eight hearty meals, from pizza to a roast dinner
The Workshop (level 28): craft sprinklers, auto-feeders and quality fertiliser at Bram's forge, and grow the Crafting skill
Find them in Me > Skills. If you played before, what you already did counts and you start up to level 5
Each skill has two perks at level 5 and two at level 10: pick the ones that suit your farm

highlights.text: Fixed a blank screen on some new phones such as the Pixel 10
New Shadows switch in Settings > Graphics

dedication.text: Thank you for farming with us. Everything on your farm is just as you left it, and the village is waking up.

highlights.text: Meet six villagers: Rosa, Old Tom, Juniper, Pip, Hazel and Bram. Visit them, chat and bring them gifts
Gifts fill their hearts. More hearts bring letters, keepsakes and handy perks for your farm
Some harvests and goods now come out silver or gold. Starred items sell for more
Your own mailbox: letters, little gifts, a villager visiting each day and finds around the farm
Missing something? Tap Ask and a friend can send it, or Hazel helps out

items.text: Farmers from before 1.8 start with friendship from all the orders they filled, up to 3 hearts with each villager
A Founding Farmer sign with your name on it is waiting in your storage. It is never sold in any shop
Give Rosa her first gift during the welcome for 200 coins
One gift a day for each villager. Their favourites count most, and birthdays count three times
Letters and story moments as your friendships grow, plus keepsakes and a portrait at 8 hearts
Each villager has a perk at 6 hearts, from extra fishing casts to faster workshops
New Book pages: a Calendar with birthdays, all your Letters and a Village Guide
Fertiliser from the Feed Mill gives a field a better chance of silver and gold
Weather: sunny days, gentle rain that helps new crops grow and brings rare fish, and misty mornings
Missed the welcome or want to see it again? Settings > Replay 1.8 welcome

highlights.text: Send feedback straight from Settings: tell us about a problem, an idea or what you love
Gifts from the Cozy Acres team now arrive by themselves, and can even include new land
Got a reward code? Type it in Friends > Gift codes and tap Open
Your farm is backed up every day, so we can help if something goes wrong
Got a farm code or link? Settings > Load a farm brings that farm into the game, even in the Play app
Make your farm yours: paint decorations, write on your Farm Sign and pick from dozens of new pieces
13 new path materials and 5 new fence styles - every fence now has a matching gate
16 new fish and the new Mythic tier - can you hook the Kraken?
Photo mode: snap your farm in golden light, add a frame and share it

items.text: Tap a decoration to paint it in one of 8 cozy colours - neighbours see your colours when they visit
New Farm Sign: write your own farm name on it
Themed sets: cottage garden, zen garden, seaside with a lighthouse, and a glowing fairy corner
Fairy lights, bunting, a pinwheel, beehive, rocking chair, duck pond, koi pond and many more
Filter chips in the Build shop make the bigger collection easy to browse
13 new paths, from sand and cobblestones to herringbone brick, blossom petals and golden bricks
New fences: white picket, bamboo, dry stone wall, low brick wall and wrought iron
Every fence has a gate that swings open when someone walks through
16 new species, from the Sea Snail to the Leafy Sea Dragon
New Mythic tier after your first legendary catch: the Kraken and the Celestial Koi
New awards and two new Fish Shack recipes
Photo mode in Settings: free camera, time of day, frames, share or save
The campfire got a cozy makeover

highlights.text: Fences join up at corners, T-junctions and crossings
Fences in a row turn to follow the line by themselves
Fishing icons now always show, on the side bar and the Biting bar
Your catch leaps out of the water as itself - no more white boxes
Go fishing at the dock from level 7, with 13 fish to catch by time of day
Help your neighbours while visiting: water a field, feed animals or tend a tree
Phone notifications when crops, animals and goods are ready - with quiet hours
Like a neighbour's farm and leave a friendly note in their guestbook

items.text: From level 7, tap the dock or the Fish button: cast, tap when the bobber dips, then keep the fish in the green
13 fish to catch by time of day, from sardines to the legendary Reef Shark, plus a few funny surprises
New Fish Shack (level 8) cooks your catch into fish cake, fish pie and seafood curry
New Fish page in the Collection Book with your biggest catches, new fishing awards and a daily quest
While visiting, water a growing field, feed hungry animals or tend a fruit tree once a day for a thank-you reward
Like a neighbour's farm and leave a friendly note in their guestbook
See who dropped by: "While you were away" and a new Visitors tab in Friends, with a Visit back button
New awards: Helping Hand and Popular Farm, plus a new daily quest
Get a gentle nudge when your crops, animals and goods are ready (Settings > Notifications)
Choose what you hear about and set quiet hours - nothing arrives at night
Hear when a neighbour sends you a gift or something sells on the Shared Market
A friendly daily reward reminder to keep your streak going
The game now checks for new versions every 10 minutes and whenever you come back
Clearer messages if a neighbour's farm cannot be opened

highlights.text: Visit a neighbour's farm from the Leaders board or your Friends list
See their fields, animals, workshops and decorations just as they left them
Tap anything on their farm to see what it is, then tap Back home
Your own farm is shared too, so friends can come and look around
Add the game to your phone's home screen from Settings
Sign in with Google to back up your farm
Cloud save: play the same farm on your phone, tablet or computer
Found a farm in the cloud? Choose which farm to keep - the other one is kept safe
Delete my online account, right in Settings

dedication.text: Updates requested by the beautiful Kacie

highlights.text: Play with friends: add neighbours with a friend code
Send gifts to friends, or share a gift code
Shared Market: list your goods and buy from other players
Leaderboards for level, farm value, charm and this week
Economy rebalance: fairer prices and rewards
Fewer hints for things you already know, with a hints setting
More fields, and clearer ways to get them
This What's new page, so you never miss an update

items.text: New Friends button: add farmers with their friend code
Your own friend code, ready to share or copy
Send items and coins with a short note - 5 gifts a day
Mailbox: gifts arrive with a jingle, open them one by one or all at once
Gift codes and links work between any two farms, no account needed
Shared Market unlocks at level 6: sell your goods to other farmers
Pick your price from 0.5x to 2.5x the value, with Quick sale, Fair and Top price
Browse by category or search, with Deal tags and goods your orders need
More listing slots as you level up, and a toast when something sells
New awards and quests: Market Trader and Good Neighbour
New Leaders button: rankings for Level, Farm value, Charm and This week
Gold, silver and bronze for the top 3, with farmer portraits
Tracker: see how much more you need to pass the next farmer
Tap any farmer to see their card and add them as a friend
Real online play with other farmers when the game is connected
Practice mode with demo neighbours, clearly labelled, until then
Settings has a new Online play section with your name and friend code
New farms start with 8 fields, and your first 8 fields are free
Every Farmhouse level allows more fields (14 at level 1, up to 70)
New Farmhouse panel shows what each upgrade adds before you pay
When your fields are full, the Shop and goal card show how to get more
Tips stop for things you already know how to do
New things still get one short intro the first time
New Helpful hints setting: All, New things only or Off
Shorter goal card once you know the basics
Levels 9-50 are paced for the long run - level 50 is a real goal
Friendlier truck: smaller crates, better pay, and it waits 16 hours
Roadside Stall prices up to 1.35x, buyers arrive faster
Big late-game goals: grand decorations and Farmhouse levels 6-8
Quests give more XP at higher levels

highlights.text: New farmer creator: Female/Male toggle with 12 ready-made avatars and colour choices

items.text: Lusher world with wildflowers
A living sea with a dock, a boat and islands
Golden dusk and moonlit nights with fireflies
Lamp glow, chimney smoke and crops swaying in the wind
One-row thumb dock and exact numbers everywhere
Live coin balance in the Shop and Barn
Crops spring up and twinkle when ripe, plus swipe combos
Seed tray closes when everything is planted
One-tap animal care
Clearer production, orders, truck, stall and merchant screens
More varied orders, and cancel waiting jobs
The merchant calls out and waves goodbye
The truck rolls in with a honk, and villagers are livelier
The goal card always shows a next step
Level-up confetti and flying rewards
Quest Go buttons take you straight there
Collection Book page rewards
Better crate opening
New loading screen and tutorial progress dots
Daily reward after the tutorial
Better sound mix and combo chimes
Vibration and smoother camera shake
Save repair, a recovery screen and import preview
An update-ready pill when a new version is out
Midnight rollover for daily quests
Welcome back summary after a break
Safe second tab: only one window plays at a time
